# Save the filtered restaurant results to cache for future reference
save_to_cache(key="filtered_restaurants_final", value=filtered_restaurants)

# Find the nearest restaurants to the filtered hotels
nearest_restaurants = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, restaurants=filtered_restaurants, groupBy="restaurant")

save_to_cache(key="nearest_restaurants", value=nearest_restaurants)
